case_assignment: One same-category case and one cyclic cross-category case per clip, preserving prior mapping: kitchen references to food, food references to tools, tools references to kitchen.
reference_selection: Unchanged nine original enrolled reference rectangles; no additional reference example selected from held-out frames.
comparison: Original first-view/adaptive; earlier conservative foreground refinement; affine overlay on conservative; isolated affine suggestions. Cached affine proposals are composed only for views the original controller actually inspected. Caching time is reported separately, not as equivalent end-to-end latency.
scoring: Review-region bbox IoU at 0.30 and 0.50, polygon-center hits on visible mask, proposals on absent targets, unjudgeable counts, failures, inherited machine tiers and runtime. Missing name in original pose records plus visual review establishes only absence from supplied images. Present name without visible mask is unjudgeable. No physical absence or kit completeness.
annotations: Observation poses/masks read only in preparation and separate scoring. Model execution sees only RGB, enrolled rectangles and predefined view order. Selected original RGB montage was visually inspected before inference.
holdout_scope: Fresh observation clips/background change, not unseen physical objects or independent customers. Related frames and recurring objects are not independent trials.
